verdictEs: Warframe Hub si quieres el dashboard panorámico completo del estado del mundo de un vistazo. Tenno Tools si lo que buscas son notificaciones activas para no perderte contenido con tiempo límite.
verdictEn: Warframe Hub if you want the full panoramic world-state dashboard at a glance. Tenno Tools if what you want is active notifications so you don't miss time-limited content.

useCases.labelEn: See the whole world state at a glance

useCases.reasonEn: Warframe Hub is the panoramic dashboard: cycles, fissures, sortie, Baro and Nightwave on a single screen.

useCases.reasonEs: Tenno Tools se enfoca en notificaciones de browser para avisarte sin que tengas que estar revisando.
useCases.reasonEn: Tenno Tools focuses on browser notifications to alert you without you having to keep checking.
